hypotheses.K1_top2_matches_full_union: Upstream-routed top-two expert unions have mean exact KL at most 110% of the full four-expert union on every corpus.
hypotheses.K2_top2_beats_fixed_rank36: Upstream-routed top-two unions reduce mean exact KL by at least 20% relative to the fixed PCA rank-36 space on every corpus.
hypotheses.K3_top2_router_closes_oracle_gap: The upstream top-two router closes at least 70% of the gap between fixed rank 36 and the per-example oracle top-two union on every corpus.
hypotheses.K4_oracle_top2_is_near_sufficient: The per-example oracle top-two union reaches median exact KL at most 0.02 on every corpus.
hypotheses.K5_top3_retains_most_union_gain: Routed top three retains at least 80% of the mean-KL gain from routed top one to the full union on every corpus.
hypotheses.K6_top2_assignment_matters: Shuffling routed top-two assignments raises mean exact KL by at least 25% on every corpus.
hypotheses.K7_two_experts_are_enough: The smallest routed k within 10% of the full union is at most two on every corpus.
hypotheses.K8_more_experts_monotonically_help: Mean exact KL is nonincreasing from routed top one through top four on every corpus.
